description: Source file implementing tensor data handling and serialization validation functions for PyTorch JIT, including tensor data extraction, schema validation for __getstate__ and __setstate__, and backend meta serialization support.

methods.name: getWriteableTensorData
methods.description: Creates a writable copy of a tensor's data, optionally converting it to CPU.

methods.name: checkHasValidSetGetState
methods.description: Validates that a class type has correctly defined __getstate__ and __setstate__ methods with matching schemas.

methods.name: GetBackendMetaAllowlist
methods.description: Returns a static allowlist of device types for backend meta serialization.

methods.name: GetBackendMetaSerialization
methods.description: Returns an array of optional pairs of backend meta serialization functions for each device type.
